title: When did you receive the organisers' notice, and what did it say changed?
summary: If you received the organisers' notice (the email of 19:38 on Tuesday, or a notice in the app), tell us the time you received it and what it said changed. Do not send us the email itself: until Dinis confirms how such a copy may be taken, we ask only for the time and the change, in your words.
closes: The time you received the notice and what it said changed. It comes in as evidence ("an attendee's account of the organisers' notice"), never as the source of a fact: Web Summit's own public page stays the source.
